name: Lists disabled Observability Plus projects
description: Lists disabled Observability Plus projects Lists the projects that are currently configured as disabled for Observability Plus on a team. GET /v1/observability/manage/configuration/projects
context:
GET /v1/observability/manage/configuration/projects
Lists the projects that are currently configured as disabled for Observability Plus on a team.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Updates a disabled Observability Plus project setting
description: Updates a disabled Observability Plus project setting Updates whether Observability Plus is disabled for a single project. PUT /v1/observability/manage/configuration/projects/{projectIdOrName}
context:
PUT /v1/observability/manage/configuration/projects/{projectIdOrName}
Updates whether Observability Plus is disabled for a single project.
Required: projectIdOrName (path) — The ID or name of the project to update
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)
